method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: S&P 500: Record streak tests sustainability – Deutsche Bank
Equities.summary: Deutsche Bank analysts highlight that the S&P 500 has just managed a ninth consecutive daily gain, taking it to fresh record highs, even with rising Oil prices. The index is close to matching or surpassing historic streaks on daily, weekly and monthly hori
Equities.reason: Broad-market momentum / risk appetite narrative: S&P hitting records is a direct signal of bullish regime (AI/tech leadership + liquidity). Elevated relevance because persistence of streak is important for market regime, but caution given geopolitical/oil headwinds.

Equities.title: Stock Market Today: Oil Approaches $100 Again After Mideast Clashes
Equities.reason: Geopolitical shock -> oil spike: Rising oil toward $100 amid Mideast clashes is a material negative for global risk assets (costs, growth, risk premium). High relevance because energy-driven growth/inflation and risk-off can quickly reverse equity leadership.

Equities.title: Indian shares seen muted as Iran tensions lift oil prices, dampen risk mode
Equities.reason: Regional equity impact from geopolitical risk and oil: muted Indian session reflects local transmission of higher oil and risk aversion — representative equity-market reaction to the global shock.

Equities.title: Stocks dip on new Iran attacks as oil prices rise
Equities.reason: Direct market reaction to escalation: equity declines tied to renewed attacks and rising oil — reinforces short-term risk-off narrative and threats to market breadth/sustainability.

Equities.title: 68,000: Nikkei 225 hits fresh record highs due to tech rally
Equities.summary: Asian equities performed mixed as traders adopted caution while monitoring US–Iran talks, with mixed signals from both sides keeping geopolitical uncertainty elevated.
Equities.reason: Regional tech-led outperformance / AI theme: Nikkei records driven by tech rally fit the global AI leadership narrative; relevance tempered by concurrent geopolitical caution noted in the summary.

Equities.title: S&P 500 climbs again — but the ‘breadth paradox’ is sending a rare warning
Equities.reason: Internal market warning: breadth paradox (indices advancing on narrow leadership) is a cautionary signal for the sustainability of the rally — negative for regime durability though not an immediate shock.

Equities.title: US stock futures trade flat as AI fervor meets US-Iran uncertainty
Equities.reason: Mixed regime signal: AI-driven bullish flows are counterbalanced by geopolitical uncertainty — net near-neutral for market direction but confirms the two-way theme dominating equities.

Equities.title: OECD warns of global slowdown as U.S.-Iran war stymies economic growth prospects
Equities.summary: The OECD has cut its global growth outlook, warning of lasting damage caused by the Middle East conflict.
Equities.reason: Macro growth downgrade tied to geopolitical conflict: large negative for global equities given hit to growth expectations and potential earnings revisions — higher relevance as it broadens beyond short-term market moves.

Equities.title: Partners Group caps withdrawals from $8.6 billion fund, shares plunge
Equities.reason: Liquidity / investor redemptions signal: caps on redemptions in a large private-capital vehicle are a negative for risk sentiment and could amplify de-risking across public markets.

Equities.title: Cliffwater’s flagship private credit fund redemption requests hit 17%
Equities.summary: Fund with net assets of $31bn aimed at retail investors limits withdrawals in latest sign of exodus from sector
Equities.reason: Signs of stress in credit/liquidity channels: elevated redemptions in private credit funds raise financial stability concerns and reduce risk appetite for equities — moderate relevance.

Equities.title: Hong Kong’s $550 Billion Exchange Fund Mulls S&P 500 Allocation
Equities.reason: Potential reallocation into US equities: flows from a large sovereign-like fund into the S&P 500 would be supportive for US indices and liquidity; relevant for cross-border demand dynamics.

Equities.title: Chinese Investors Exit Hong Kong Stocks as AI Woos Money Onshore
Equities.reason: Flow shift and market concentration: allocation moving onshore (and into AI winners) weakens Hong Kong breadth and highlights concentration risk — negative for HK equities and shows where global equity flows are headed.

Equities.title: Morning Bid: Marvell, a fitting name for the latest AI darling
Equities.reason: Semiconductor / AI leadership reinforcement: coverage of Marvell as an AI darling underscores the dominant tech/AI leadership theme lifting parts of the market; supportive for sector leadership and index concentration.

Equities.title: Exclusive: SpaceX plans to raise $75 billion in IPO at $135 per share, source says
Equities.reason: Major IPO pipeline signal: a jumbo SpaceX IPO would be a material event for primary market activity and tech investor sentiment — positive for equity market liquidity and investor appetite, though idiosyncratic.

Rates.title: US Dollar: Strong labour data challenge rate-cut case – MUFG
Rates.summary: MUFG’s Michael Wan highlights that stronger-than-expected US labour data have pushed US yields higher and supported the Dollar.
Rates.reason: Stronger US labour data are explicitly linked to higher US yields and a firmer dollar — a direct negative for bond prices (yields up). Clear, immediate transmission to US rates and monetary policy expectations.

Rates.title: Warsh set to revamp Fed’s signals to Wall Street
Rates.summary: Former top officials say central bank chair is keen to roll back forward guidance on rates
Rates.reason: Change in Fed communication/forward guidance is a major regime signal for rates markets — rolling back guidance likely implies more uncertainty and a tilt toward higher-for-longer rate expectations, pressuring bond prices.

Rates.title: Fed Chair Warsh makes first hires at central bank, including ‘Project 2025’ author
Rates.summary: The new Fed chair has made his first hires. One wrote the Fed chapter in conservative policy blueprint "Project 2025."
Rates.reason: Hiring choices signal the new chair's policy leanings and likely tighter communication/approach; supportive of market repricing toward less-dovish policy and higher yields, though confirmatory rather than novel.

Rates.title: BoJ’s Ueda: Our basic stance is to continue raising interest rates
Rates.summary: Bank of Japan (BoJ) Governor Kazuo Ueda reaffirms that the direction of the monetary policy remains on the upside, while speaking at the Kisaragi-kai Meeting on Wednesday.
Rates.reason: Explicit BoJ guidance to continue raising rates points to higher JGB yields and ripples across global fixed income (risk-free curve repricing). Direct and material for rates markets.

Rates.title: UBS sees inflation-driven ECB hikes giving way to rate cuts in 2027
Rates.reason: UBS outlook implies further near-term ECB hikes (higher eurozone yields) before cuts later — near-term tightening is negative for bond prices in Europe and shapes forward curve pricing.

Rates.title: OECD warns of ‘dark scenario’ if Gulf energy crisis drags on
Rates.summary: Growth rates would tumble to levels rarely seen outside of major global events such as the Covid-19 pandemic
Rates.reason: A prolonged energy shock causing a sharp growth slowdown increases safe-haven demand for bonds (yields down). This is a macro downside risk that would be supportive of bond prices if realised.

Rates.title: PGIM Bets on Hungary Extending Best Emerging-Market Bond Rally
Rates.reason: Headline signals continued demand and rally in EM sovereign bonds (lower yields). Relevant to emerging-market fixed income flows and cross-border rate positioning.

Rates.title: India Said to Ready Tax Cut Plans to Attract Foreign Bond Buyers
Rates.reason: Policy measures to attract foreign bond buyers would boost demand for Indian debt and put downward pressure on yields — direct impact on sovereign bond markets and global portfolio flows.

Rates.title: Bank Lending in India Hits Two-Year High as Companies Skip Bonds
Rates.reason: Shift toward bank lending and away from bond issuance reduces corporate bond supply and changes credit market dynamics — modest supportive signal for bond prices but more micro/credit-specific.

Rates.title: South Korea Inflation Accelerated to 26-Month High in May
Rates.reason: Rising inflation in South Korea increases the likelihood of higher local interest rates and higher sovereign yields — a direct negative for domestic bond prices and relevant for Asian rates dynamics.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: Key levels watched as BoJ speech looms – MUFG
FX.summary: MUFG’s Michael Wan notes that stronger US labour data have lifted US yields and supported the US Dollar (USD), complicating prospects for near-term Fed rate cuts.
FX.reason: Highlights stronger US labour data lifting US yields and supporting the USD — reinforces USD-strength/risk-off narrative that pressures other currencies (JPY). Mid-high relevance as it ties macro data to FX moves ahead of BoJ talk.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: Intervention risk rises near 160 against US Dollar – DBS
FX.summary: DBS Bank’s Philip Wee highlights that USD/JPY is trading around 160, a level where intervention risk remains high.
FX.reason: USD/JPY trading near 160 with explicit intervention risk is a market-moving FX narrative — signals further downside pressure on JPY from USD strength but also potential policy backstop. High relevance due to intervention implication.

FX.title: Yen slips to key 160 level as Gulf hostilities boost dollar
FX.reason: Major wire story linking Middle East escalation to safe-haven USD demand and a slide in JPY through the 160 area — large-market, high-impact driver for FX liquidity and flows (strong USD, weak JPY). High relevance.

FX.title: United States Dollar Index (DXY) Price Forecast: Testing 99.40 resistance amid risk aversion
FX.summary: The safe-haven US Dollar (USD) is showing strength on Wednesday as tensions in the Middle East escalate, casting doubt on the fate of a stalled peace process.
FX.reason: Direct USD-index story showing DXY strength on Middle East risk aversion — central to USD-centric FX narratives and explains broad currency weakness. High relevance as it sets the cross-market tone.

FX.title: Euro faces selling pressure on renewed US-Iran tensions
FX.summary: The Euro (EUR) is down against its major currency peers, trading 0.1% lower to near 1.1618 during the European trading session on Wednesday.
FX.reason: EUR under pressure driven by USD safe-haven flows from Middle East tensions — clear USD transmission to EUR/USD. Medium relevance as it reinforces DXY-driven downside for euro.

FX.title: Indian Rupee tumbles due to FIIs selling, rising oil prices
FX.summary: The Indian Rupee (INR) falls sharply against the US Dollar (USD) on Wednesday. The USD/INR pair jumps to near 95.78 as oil prices extend recovery due to renewed hostilities in the Middle East region, and the continuous outflow of foreign funds from the Indian
FX.reason: Combines EM FX outflows (FII selling), oil-driven terms-of-trade pressure, and USD safe-haven strength — directly relevant to INR/USD flows and regional FX stress. High relevance for EM currency narrative.

FX.title: Indian rupee could fall to 98/USD by July amid energy crisis, BofA Securities exec says
FX.reason: Wire forecast of a sharp INR depreciation linked to an energy shock is a high-impact FX call that would drive USD/INR positioning and potential policy reaction. High relevance due to size and policy implications.

FX.title: India’s plunging rupee puts surprise rate hike bets on the table
FX.summary: A falling currency and rising risk of higher inflation could prompt India's central bank to hike interest rates.
FX.reason: Policy-hike-as-defence narrative is a direct FX transmission: if CB raises rates to defend INR, that would be supportive for the rupee (partial counter-signal). Lower relevance because it's anticipatory, not an executed intervention.

FX.title: HSBC Asset’s Little Sees Weaker Dollar on Shift in Data Reaction
FX.reason: Prominent asset manager arguing for a weaker USD is a notable contrarian view to the prevailing risk-off USD bid — included as a lower-relevance counterpoint to the dominant USD-strength story.

FX.title: Indonesian Rupiah hits fresh record lows as risk aversion increases
FX.summary: USD/IDR trades near the record high of 18,037 reached on Wednesday. The US Dollar (USD) remains firmly on the front foot, driving the currency pair higher as a sharp escalation of geopolitical tensions in the Middle East fuels a sweeping wave of safe-haven dem
FX.reason: USD safe-haven flows and risk aversion pushing USD/IDR to record highs — clear EM FX stress tied to geopolitics and USD strength. Medium-high relevance for EM FX risk narrative.

FX.title: USD/CAD Price Forecast: Stands firm near 1.3850 as bullish USD counters rising Oil prices
FX.summary: The USD/CAD pair attracts fresh buyers following the previous day's directionless price moves and sticks to modest intraday gains, around mid-1.3800s, through the first half of the European session on Wednesday.
FX.reason: Notes USD strength offsetting supportive oil moves for CAD — direct USD-driven CAD pressure. Medium relevance as it captures commodity-currency interplay.

FX.title: Australian Dollar extends soft GDP-inspired slide; remains confined in range vs USD
FX.summary: The AUD/USD pair drops to the 0.7150 area during the first half of the European session on Wednesday, reversing the previous day's positive move amid a broadly firmer US Dollar (USD).
FX.reason: Direct AUD/USD weakness driven by a firmer USD and softer domestic data — representative of G10 downside into the USD-strength/risk-off impulse. Medium relevance.

FX.title: Danish Krone: Record low against Euro tests central bank stance – Danske Bank
FX.summary: Danske Research Team notes that EUR/DKK hit a new historic high at 7.4739, with the Danish central bank refraining from FX intervention in May. They argue that while the bank shows patience with upward pressure, continued strength would likely prompt action to
FX.reason: EUR/DKK hitting record highs raises intervention risk — a central-bank FX story (non-USD cross) with potential policy/market implications. Included for central-bank intervention theme; moderate relevance.

FX.title: Taiwan’s ‘Big Boss’ Central Bank Is Stamping Out Currency Swings
FX.reason: Central-bank active FX management is a meaningful local FX theme — suggests policy support to limit volatility in TWD. Lower relevance to broad USD narrative but important for regional FX stability.

Commodities.title: India Central Bank Says Report on Selling Gold Is Incorrect
Commodities.reason: Direct central-bank denial reduces the probability of official gold reserve sales and short-term supply overhang — supportive for gold prices but a relatively contained, country-specific development.

Commodities.title: Gold Edges Lower as Robust US Jobs Data Point to Higher Rates
Commodities.reason: Stronger US jobs data lifts Fed rate-hike expectations and real yields, which is a clear negative for gold's opportunity cost and investor demand — high macro relevance.

Commodities.title: Gold refreshes weekly low, below $4,450 as USD sticks to gains on Mideast risks, Fed bets
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) continues to lose ground through the first half of the European session on Wednesday and slides back below the $4,450 level, hitting a fresh weekly low in the last hour.
Commodities.reason: Intraday price weakness as USD strength and renewed Fed-hike positioning weigh on gold; relevant short-term price action but lower structural impact than macro data.

Commodities.title: Brent Oil rises above $97.00 as Iran's ceasefire wobbles
Commodities.summary: Crude prices rise for their third day in a row on Wednesday, as fresh hostilities between the US and Iran cast further doubt about a fragile ceasefire.
Commodities.reason: Escalation risk in the Middle East raises supply-risk premium for crude — materially bullish for oil prices and market risk backdrop; high relevance given persistent geopolitical driver.

Commodities.title: Oil Holds Two-Day Gain on Discordant US-Iran Peace Talk Reports
Commodities.reason: Ongoing mixed reports on US-Iran talks are sustaining oil risk premium and recent multi-day gains — supportive for prices but somewhat incremental to the broader Middle East narrative.

Commodities.title: Oil Prices Rise as Iran and U.S. Exchange Strikes
Commodities.reason: Confirmed military exchanges between Iran and the US increase short-term crude risk premia and push prices higher — clear directional impact on oil markets.

Commodities.title: India’s Oil Demand Growth Set for Pandemic Low on War Crunch
Commodities.reason: War-related disruption and economic disruption hitting India’s oil demand growth is a meaningful regional demand headwind for crude — negative for oil fundamentals in the near term.

Commodities.title: The United States is a major energy exporter and importer, especially for petroleum
Commodities.summary: Total energy exports from the United States reached a record 31 quadrillion British thermal units (quads) in 2025, 2% more than the previous record set in 2024. U.S. energy imports were 21 quads, down 5% from 2024. Taken together, net trade—total imports less
Commodities.reason: Record US energy exports point to strong US production/export capacity; modestly supportive for global commodity demand/signals but not an immediate price shock.

Commodities.title: Natural gas for power generation flat this summer, record high expected in 2027
Commodities.summary: We forecast natural gas consumption by the U.S. electric power sector this summer will remain near recent highs and set a record next summer in our May Short-Term Energy Outlook (STEO). Despite a 2% increase in overall U.S. electricity demand this summer, we e
Commodities.reason: EIA projection of near-term steady demand and record consumption next year is supportive for natural gas prices, especially for forward seasonal tightness concerns.

Commodities.title: Most planned natural gas pipeline capacity additions in 2026 and 2027 originate in Texas
Commodities.summary: Developers plan to bring approximately 44.9 billion cubic feet per day (Bcf/d) of new pipeline capacity online in the United States in 2026 and 2027, according to our latest Natural Gas Pipeline Projects Tracker. Approximately 70% (31.6 Bcf/d) of this new capa
Commodities.reason: Large planned pipeline additions concentrated in Texas imply materially higher US gas takeaway capacity and potential easing of regional price dislocations — a supply-side headwind for natural-gas prices.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin hits lowest since February as crypto competes for liquidity with blockbuster IPOs
Crypto.summary: Bitcoin continues to decline as stocks hit record highs, with investors also eyeing big IPOs.
Crypto.reason: Macro flow: capital rotation into equities/IPOs draining liquidity from crypto. Relevant to crypto asset-class flows and short-term price pressure on BTC — negative directional impact with high relevance.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin plunges below $66,000 as global stocks, AI trades hit fresh records
Crypto.reason: Price action: large BTC selloff concurrent with equity strength. Strong negative signal for crypto risk-on positioning and liquidity; high relevance to market momentum and sentiment.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin's 'fear gauge' surges nearly 20%, its biggest jump since Feb. 5 crash
Crypto.reason: Sentiment indicator spike implies elevated panic/liquidation risk. Negative for near-term crypto flows and risk-taking; high relevance as a volatility/liquidity signal.

Crypto.title: Bullish crypto bets lose $1.6 billion as ETH, SOL, DOGE drop 9%
Crypto.reason: Liquidations and leveraged losses across altcoins indicate deleveraging and forced selling — clear negative for market liquidity and risk appetite; very relevant to crypto market dynamics.

Crypto.title: Prediction market traders bet bitcoin's selloff has further to run
Crypto.reason: Market positioning via prediction markets signals expectation of further downside — reinforces the negative momentum narrative; moderately high relevance.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin's slide to $66,000 is accelerating a shift into digital dollars
Crypto.reason: Flow migration into stablecoins/digital dollars suggests risk-off redeployment away from volatile crypto assets — negative for spot BTC/altcoin demand but important for stablecoin adoption narrative.

Crypto.title: Mastercard expands onchain settlement in bet on stablecoins and always-on finance
Crypto.reason: Institutional adoption/use-case: Mastercard widening on‑chain settlement is a positive infrastructure and stablecoin adoption signal for crypto payments and fiat-rail integration; meaningful positive for medium-term adoption.

Crypto.title: Coinbase backs Ethena ahead of savings product launch for exchange's 100 million users
Crypto.reason: Exchange-led product adoption (stablecoin/savings) increases on‑ramp utility and potential stablecoin demand; positive but more incremental than broad macro flows.

Crypto.title: U.S. sanctions Iranian crypto exchanges in ongoing war against the country
Crypto.reason: Regulatory/enforcement action: sanctions restrict regional crypto activity and highlight geopolitical/legal risk for exchanges and cross-border flows; negative for adoption in affected markets and adds regulatory uncertainty.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin set for 'choppy summer' as capital chases high-flying AI stocks, K33 says
Crypto.reason: Thematic allocation risk: analysts flag capital rotation toward AI equities reducing crypto demand — negative for BTC/crypto near-term seasonality and flows.

Crypto.title: Hyperliquid is beating ethereum in trading volume on some days as big money rotates, says FalconX
Crypto.reason: Flow/venue rotation: evidence of trading volume shifting within crypto markets (potentially away from BTC/ETH) — modestly negative for incumbent liquidity but lower relevance than market-wide sell signals.

Crypto.title: Bullish XRP signals are piling up. The price keeps falling.
Crypto.reason: Idiosyncratic altcoin story: mixed technical/baseline signals but continued price decline. Low relevance to broad crypto market narrative; treated as minor negative signal.
